notes: Merged birth, marriage, death certificates and divorce papers into Civil registration certificate (types); baptism and confirmation certificates into Religious rite certificate, with the ketubah moved there as a marriage-contract type. Model-less entries (Taufschein, Certificat d'études primaires, Reward of merit card) became types. Nothing dropped.
